8 distinct consecutive keyposes, readingorder:
1 POISED: wristup a little, index andmiddle loosely lifted, fingertips x135,y180 and x155,y220. Otherfingersrelaxed.
2 PREPARE: index/middle extend gracefully more horizontally left, fingers separated, wriststill.

4 FOLLOWTHROUGH: deepestdownbeat x155,y305 andx212,y328, slight palmtilt, otherfingersnaturallytucked.

6 RELEASE: fingers unfurl alittle more while wrist lifts, fingertipsslightlyhigher.
7 SETTLE: wrist relaxes towardinitialposition, leading fingers softly curved, no sudden change.
8 HOLD: elegant relaxed conductinghand hovering, index/middle naturally curveddown-left atx135,y215 andx170,y258, iconic finalpose similar reference finalframe.

Critical: consistent scale and exact wrist anchor, consecutive believable animationposes. No two hands inonecell, no offer/receivegesture, no holdinganything, no fullyopenpalmfacingcamera.
